'''Mencho Tallboy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served in the [[Marblewood security force|security force]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]]. He was one of the many security guards working for the [[Black Sun sector chief|sector chief]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], [[Avrak Villachor]]. While staying on Wukkar, the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Qazadi]] used Tallboy's name as an alias.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
